pins.label: JP-G01
pins.notes: Three-reward Japes pilot. Actual ROM coordinates; access and full campaign balance remain subject to later M6 review. Stable private reward slot 1.

pins.label: JP-BP01
pins.notes: Gray Kasplat. Take its blueprint to Snide for GB slot4, one of three total.

pins.label: JP-SW01
pins.notes: Silver orange-emblem switch outside the full cage. Krusha bazooka171 only. Cage opening is map-local until its GB is collected.

pins.label: JP-PAD
pins.notes: Silver Krusha shout pad. A successful paid shout summons the rare Klump after the animation. Claimed reward hides this pad.

pins.label: JP-KLUMP
pins.notes: Rare silver-blue/purple Klump: native AI at twice ordinary size, five distinct bazooka hits, three double-damage grenades per volley. Drops GB at its actual death position. Private slot0.
